sources.title: Overview - MuJoCo Documentation
sources.snippet: MuJoCo further exposes a large number of utility functions for computing physics-related quantities. MuJoCo can be used to implement model-based computations such as control synthesis, state estimation, system identification, mechanism design, data analysis through inverse dynamics, and parallel sampling for machine learning applications.
